parsed.name: EPICS电动位移轴
parsed.description: 一种由EPICS motor record控制的实验室电机运动轴，通常连接线性位移台、旋转台或其他机电执行机构，用于在实验中进行精密定位、扫描、回零和行程限制管理，常见于束线、光学平台和样品操控系统。
parsed.description_en: A motorized laboratory motion axis controlled through an EPICS motor record, typically attached to a linear stage, rotation stage, or other electromechanical actuator. It is used for precision positioning, scanning, homing, and travel-limit management in beamlines, optical setups, and sample-handling systems.
